description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Warwick''' gains damage reduction for up to 2.75 seconds. ''Primal Howl'' can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically after the duration.
description.text: Active: Warwick gains damage reduction for up to 2.75 seconds. Primal Howl can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically after the duration.

description3.raw: '''Recast:''' '''Warwick''' howls, ending ''Primal Howl's'' effects and [[File:Flee icon.png|20px|link=Flee|An icon representing the keyword Flee]] [[:Flee|fearing]] nearby enemies for 1 second, [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowing]] them by 90%.
description3.text: Recast: Warwick howls, ending Primal Howl's effects and fearing nearby enemies for 1 second, slowing them by 90%.

description4.raw: Starting ''[[File:Warwick Infinite Duress.png|20xpx|border|link=Warwick#Infinite Duress|An icon for Warwick's ability Infinite Duress]] [[Warwick#Infinite Duress|Infinite Duress']]'' channel while ''Primal Howl'' is active will initiate the recast without ending the damage reduction buff prematurely.
description4.text: Starting Infinite Duress' channel while Primal Howl is active will initiate the recast without ending the damage reduction buff prematurely.

description5.raw: ''Primal Howl's recast [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|resets]] '''Warwick's''' basic attack timer.''
description5.text: Primal Howl's recast resets Warwick's basic attack timer.

notes.raw: *The initial cast and the manual recast count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]] and triggering [[File:Kassadin Force Pulse.png|20xpx|border|link=Kassadin#Force Pulse|An icon for Kassadin's ability Force Pulse]] [[Kassadin#Force Pulse|Force Pulse's]] passive. **If the ability is not manually recasted, the secondary effect will trigger without being considered as an ability activation. * The basic attack reset is not considered one for [[File:Hail of Blades rune.png|20xpx|link=Hail of Blades|An icon representing Hail of Blades]] [[Hail of Blades]]. * The recast's howling animation has a 0.25-second [[File:Lockout icon 2.png|20px|link=Terminology#Lockout|An icon representing the keyword Lockout]] [[:Terminology#Lockout|lockout]] time. ** This will also cancel '''Warwick's''' basic attack. ** '''Warwick''' cannot attack or cast abilities during the animation, instead the last input will be buffered to play after it ends. * '''Warwick''' will automatically recast if he enters [[File:Revival icon.png|20px|link=Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|An icon representing the keyword Resurrection]] [[:Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|resurrection]].
notes.text:
The initial cast and the manual recast count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
*If the ability is not manually recasted, the secondary effect will trigger without being considered as an ability activation.
The basic attack reset is not considered one for Hail of Blades.
The recast's howling animation has a 0.25-second lockout time.
* This will also cancel Warwick's basic attack.
* Warwick cannot attack or cast abilities during the animation, instead the last input will be buffered to play after it ends.
Warwick will automatically recast if he enters resurrection.
